summary: Comprehensive testing of SketchSQL app - all core features working. Backend APIs (health, generate-sql, import-sql) all pass. Frontend: welcome screen, example schemas, canvas with nodes, SQL auto-generation, dialect toggle, add table, column inline editing, save diagram modal, import SQL modal, AI Assistant tab all functional.

issues: Properties tab shows 'Select a table or relationship to edit its properties.' message even when a table is selected (clicking first node did not populate properties panel - may require a more direct click on the node header). This is minor and may be a selector/test issue rather than a real bug.

action_items: Minor: Verify that clicking a table node header (not column area) correctly populates the Properties tab - from screenshots, clicking a column row opened the inline column editor instead of the properties panel
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is well-structured, all endpoints work correctly
SQL generation handles MySQL/PostgreSQL dialects with topological sort for FK ordering
No data-testid on AI Assistant tab or Properties tab panel containers - 'ai-assistant-tab' and 'properties-tab' testids not found, making future automated testing harder
App stores state client-side only (localStorage/IndexedDB) - no persistence backend, expected per design
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows verified: welcome screen (3 options), example schemas (4 schemas), canvas nodes (E-commerce loads 6 nodes), SQL auto-generation, MySQL/PostgreSQL dialect toggle, Add Table, column inline editor, Save Diagram modal, Import SQL modal, AI Assistant tab with prompt chips and Analyze Schema button. Backend tests 6/6 passing. Minor: Properties tab data-testid attributes missing on AI Assistant and Properties tab panel containers.
rca_of_issues: Properties panel shows empty because node click in test selected column row instead of table header, triggering inline column editor. Not a code bug - test interaction issue.
